title: 2019: ESA Aeolus and Starlink 44 (scripted from ESA's published timeline, compressed)

notes.-240: Both satellites detect the encounter and send PROPOSE with their registered class and fuel.
notes.-230: Both compute the same verdict from shared data; the agreed yielder burns early and small. Plan committed.

notes.-240: 28 Aug: US military alert, 1 in 50,000. ESA emails SpaceX; SpaceX replies it has no plans to move.
notes.-180: 29 Aug: risk crosses ESA's 1 in 10,000 threshold.
notes.-120: 1 Sep: risk about 1 in 1,000. A paging-system bug means the follow-up is never seen.
notes.-50: 2 Sep: Aeolus burns alone, half an orbit before closest approach. No shared record.
